integrity: The theorem follows from explicit binary-cut directional derivatives, the graph coarea identity, a sorted-subset maximization, and an Euler semigroup limit. The script is a finite exact-rational corroboration, not an infinite proof or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite two-by-q bicliques with \(q\ge3\), independently positive edge variation weights and fixed unweighted degree-normalized random-walk heat transitions. The classification does not cover arbitrary heat rates, larger left classes, or sharp positive-time expansion factors.
title: A sorted-cut criterion for weighted-variation contraction of normalized heat on \(K_{2,q}\)
